text: 1. Healthy physical and mental condition, non-Chinese citizens holding valid foreign ordinary passports, with an age limit of generally no more than 30 years old. Applicants under the age of 18 must provide a guardianship certificate (the age is calculated as of September 1st of the year of enrollment). The guardian must be a resident of Suzhou with a permanent local household registration. Specific regulations for international student recognition can be found on the website of the Ministry of Education of China: http://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A20/moe_850/202006/t20200609_464159.html 2. High school graduation or equivalent educational attainment.
